detail: Proposing a crosswalk requires TASKS.UPDATE, which is admin-only. Whether practising engineers (supervisors) should be able to propose candidate mappings is an authorization decision, not an architecture defect.
Current proposal: crosswalks do not participate in Knowledge Pack publication and have no published state. Whether crosswalks must ever travel with a published pack is a product decision.
Only industry is modelled structurally; jurisdiction and lifecycle phase are deferred to free text until evidence of need.
Hierarchical external codes are represented as an optional text path today. Whether a full external hierarchy is needed later is undecided.
The classification tables required to populate external_classification for these two authorities are not accessible. Architecture is unaffected; population is blocked until access exists.

activity_codes.iso_maintenance_reference and cause_codes.iso_failure_cause_reference carry unverifiable ISO14224-* lineage. Must NEVER be bulk-imported as trusted mappings; at most candidates requiring independent verification.

Requiring at least one evidence row for an approved crosswalk is a cross-table rule and therefore remains a service/domain responsibility, consistent with migration 013 documented boundary. Must be enforced in the future implementation, not only documented.
PROJECT_SOURCE_SYNCHRONIZATION_REQUIRED remains open (carried from M5R.2). No repository-resident Project Source exists, so no conflict could be evaluated.
